way I like it, and I don't even ask!
ES:

un {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}sucre{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, pas plus{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Robusto {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}me prépare mon café

{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}un cucchiaino{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} di zucchero{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Quando vengo qua, non devo dire

Ich mag meinen Kaffee mit {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}einem

{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Kofi {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}den perfekten Kaffee kriege,

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Good morning!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} We ended up running
into each other here yet again,
didn't we? How nice to see you!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Buenos días!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Qué cosas, volvemos
a coincidir aquí l{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}s dos.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Sé que es
casualidad,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} ¡pero me alegro!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bonjour !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Quel plaisir de te revoir !
Nous devons être {{TAG:000E:0006:08006C006900E90073000A006C006900E90065007300}} par le
destin !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Buongiorno!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Guarda un po'... Io e te
finiamo con l'incontrarci sempre
qui! Beh, mi fa piacere, sai?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Guten Morgen!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Sind wir uns nicht
schon einmal hier über den Weg
gelaufen?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Schön, dich zu sehen!

EN:
Cafés are such wonderful places.
A cup of coffee here can make
just about anyone happy.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I hope that I can help make someone
out there as happy just by helping
get a letter to where it needs to be.
ES:
Las cafeterías pueden llegar a ser
sitios mágicos.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Una buena taza de
café le sube el ánimo a cualquiera.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ojalá mi trabajo cause el mismo
efecto y las cartas que entrego
le alegren la vida a la gente.
FR:
Quel endroit merveilleux. Une tasse
de café, et on oublie tous ses
soucis !
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je me demande si j'arrive à rendre
les gens heureux grâce au courrier
que je distribue...
IT:
Questa caffetteria è speciale.
Chiunque si sentirebbe meglio
dopo una tazza di questo caffè!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Spero che anche il mio ufficio
postale possa essere così tanto
di aiuto ai nostri concittadini.
DE:
Cafés sind magische Orte!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Eine Tasse Kaffee hier kann einem
ein Lächeln aufs Gesicht zaubern.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hoffentlich mache ich die Leute
ebenso glücklich, wenn ich ihre
Briefe anderen zukommen lasse!
TRANSLATION:
Kafeler harika yerler, değil mi?
Bir fincan kahve beni mutlu
ediyor. Ben{{TAG:0003:0001:}} de mektupları teslim
ederken birilerinin gününü
güzelleştirebiliyorsam ne mutlu bana.

EN:
The coffee here is what keeps my
happy motor running.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Thanks to {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Brewster{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, I've enjoyed
a delicious cup of coffee,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} so I think
I'll be able to do my best at work!
ES:
El café de este sitio me mantiene
despierta todo el día.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si no fuera por {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Fígaro {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}y su delicioso
café,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} creo que no podría darlo todo
en el trabajo.
FR:
Le café qu'ils font ici me redonne
toujours l'énergie dont j'ai besoin !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aujourd'hui encore, grâce au
délicieux café que me prépare
{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Robusto{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}...
... je vais pouvoir être au top
au travail !
IT:
Il caffè che fanno qua riesce
a darmi la carica che mi serve
per affrontare la giornata.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Grazie a {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Bartolo {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}mi sono bevuta
il miglior caffè della città.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} Ora
so che oggi lavorerò al meglio!
DE:
Der Kaffee hier hält mich immer
auf Zack!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Dank {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Kofi{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} und seinem köstlichen
Kaffee kann ich auf Hochtouren
arbeiten!
TRANSLATION:
Kahve benim mutlu motorumu
çalıştırıyor{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}!{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}} Bir{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} fincan içince
işimi daha iyi{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} yapabiliyormuşum
gibi geliyor.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}On nice days like today,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} I feel like
the coffee tastes even better than
usual. Don't you think so?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}En días tan buenos como hoy,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} tengo
la sensación de que el café está más
rico si cabe. ¿No opinas lo mismo?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je trouve le café bien meilleur
quand il fait beau comme
aujourd'hui... {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Pas toi ?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}An Tagen wie diesen schmeckt der
Kaffee noch besser als sonst, finde
ich. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Meinst du nicht auch?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hava güzel olunca{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} kahvenin tadı
bile daha güzel geliyor sanki.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Days that start off with gloomy
weather make me feel like cheering
up with a delicious cup of coffee.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Cuando el día llega con el cielo
cubierto, no hay mejor forma de
recibirlo que con una taza de café.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Quand les nuages pointent le bout
de leur nez dès le matin,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} ça me
donne envie de boire du café...
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Le café me redonne l'énergie dont
j'ai besoin pour la journée !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Le giornatacce come oggi mi fanno
venire ancora più voglia di tirarmi
su con una bella tazza di caffè.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wenn Wolken am Himmel hängen,
muss man seinen Tag mit einer
schönen Tasse Kaffee beginnen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hava kapalıysa bir fincan
kahveyle içimizi açarız!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sadly, it's raining this morning,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} but
having a delicious cup of coffee
blows any gloomy feelings away.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aunque tengamos la mañana pasada
por agua,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} una rica taza de café hará
que no nos agüe la fiesta.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yağmur biraz iç{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} karartıyor ama
sıcak kahve o kasveti dağıtıyor.

FR:
Brrr... Il fait froid, ce matin, tu ne
trouves pas ?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Rien de tel qu'un café
fumant pour se réchauffer !

EN:
Sometimes I wish my older sister
and I could enjoy coffee together{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Our work hours are always the
exact opposite of each other,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} so
the timing never really works out{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
ES:
Es una pena no poder disfrutar de
un café con mi hermana mayor{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Nuestros turnos son totalmente
opuestos{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} y es imposible coincidir{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
FR:
J'aimerais pouvoir boire un café
avec ma grande sœur, de temps
en temps{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Mais nos heures de travail sont
complètement opposées, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}alors
c'est impossible{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
IT:
A volte penso che sarebbe bello
venire qui con la mia sorellona
a bere una bella tazza di caffè{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Purtroppo il suo turno finisce
quando il mio comincia,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} quindi
non ci riusciremo mai{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
DE:
Manchmal wünsche ich mir, dass
meine Schwester und ich zusammen
hier sitzen{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Wir arbeiten eben abwechselnd.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Eine gemeinsame Tasse Kaffee ist
deshalb reines Wunschdenken{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
TRANSLATION:
Keşke bir gün ablamla burada
oturup kahve{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} içebilsek{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}. Çalışma
saatlerimiz o kadar ters ki{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
doğru düzgün görüşemiyoruz{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Pete{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} says he often comes here
around the same time as I do in
the morning{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}But I've yet to run into him here.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}I've often thought it would be nice
to enjoy coffee together,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} so I'm a
little sad we haven't had the chance.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Carturo{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} afirma que suele venir por
aquí a la misma hora que yo.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}La pena es que todavía no hemos
coincidido.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Jo,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} es una lástima que aún no
hayamos disfrutado de ningún
café juntos.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Antoine{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} dit qu'il vient souvent ici à
la même heure que moi{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Mais je ne suis encore jamais
tombée sur lui.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Ça me ferait plaisir qu'on boive
un café ensemble.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Un jour,
peut-être !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Tino {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}mi ha detto che spesso viene
qui di mattina, più o meno
alla stessa ora in cui arrivo io{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}... ma non ci incrociamo mai.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Penso spesso che sarebbe bello
prendere il caffè con lui,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} ma per
ora non è mai successo. Peccato!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Peter{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} meint, dass er morgens immer
zur selben Zeit hier ist wie ich{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Aber ich hab ihn hier noch gar nicht
gesehen!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Ich hätte mich gefreut, mit ihm ein
Tässchen Kaffee zu trinken.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Schade,
dass es bis jetzt nicht geklappt hat!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Pete{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} de sabahları aynı saatlerde{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}
çalıştığımızı söylüyor{{TAG:0000:0004:}} ama
nedense hiç denk gelemiyoruz{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}.
Biraz üzücü aslında.

FR:
{{TAG:000C:0001:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Oh, tiens,{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Robusto{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} !{{TAG:0007:0001:}} J'aimerais
ramener quelque chose à boire à
ma grande sœur, {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Élisabec{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
Pourrais-tu me préparer un café à
emporter, s'il te plaît ?{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
IT:
{{TAG:000C:0001:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Ah, a proposito.{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Bartolo{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},{{TAG:0007:0001:}} vorrei
portare qualcosa anche alla mia
sorella maggiore, {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Polly{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
Potresti preparare un caffè anche
per lei?{{TAG:000C:0009:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}When I'm here sipping my cup of
morning coffee and having a casual
chat with you, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}...
I feel like my day has really begun!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tu sais, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}... Quand je bois
mon café en ta compagnie et que
nous discutons...
Je me rends compte que la journée
a bien commencé !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Quando sono qui a bermi il mio
caffè mattutino e a farmi due
chiacchiere con te, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}...
... so che la giornata è iniziata
al meglio!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hier an meinem Guten-Morgen-
Kaffee zu nippen und ganz entspannt
mit dir zu reden, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0000:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
So kann mein Tag gerne immer
beginnen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sabah kahvemi içip seninle biraz
sohbet edince, {{TAG:0005:0000:}}, gün gerçekten
başlamış gibi hissediyorum.

EN:
I actually first started coming here
because of something my older
sister did.
One evening at the end of my shift,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Phyllis{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} brought me a cup of coffee
from the{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}} Roost{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Oh my, it was so delicious{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
I've been a huge fan ever since!
FR:
Pour tout te dire, c'est grâce à ma
grande sœur que j'ai découvert cet
endroit !
Un soir, après le travail, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Élisabec{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
m'a apporté une tasse du café
qu'ils font ici.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je l'ai trouvé tellement bon{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
que je suis finalement devenue
une habituée !
IT:
In realtà ho cominciato a venire qui
grazie alla mia sorellona.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}Una sera, alla fine del mio turno,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Polly {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}mi ha portato del caffè
direttamente dalla {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Piccionaia{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Era buonissimo! Una vera delizia{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Da quel momento ho deciso di
bere esclusivamente il loro caffè!
DE:
Ich bin wegen meiner älteren
Schwester auf den Laden hier
gekommen.
Als ich eines Abends fertig war mit
der Arbeit,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} brachte mir {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Peggy {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}einen
Kaffee aus dem {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Taubenschlag{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Oh, er war so unsagbar köstlich{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Seitdem komme ich nicht los davon!
TRANSLATION:
Roost'a ilk kez ablam sayesinde
gelmiştim. Bir gece
vardiyasından{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} sonra bana buradan
kahve{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} getirmişti. O{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} günden{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} beri müdavimim!

IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tanti clienti vengono qui da soli,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
quindi non trovo imbarazzante
presentarmi qui senza compagnia.
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Devo dire, però,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} che sarebbe bello
poter venire qua con qualcuno
di speciale{{TAG:0007:0004:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0005:}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}{{TAG:0003:000F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Oh, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}scusa!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0009:}}Non mi ero accorta che
stavo parlando a voce alta{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Ero
persa nei miei pensieri! {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}Che figura!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Viele Leute kommen allein hierher.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Das macht es einfacher für mich,
auch ohne Begleitung zu erscheinen.
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Aber{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} es wäre sehr schön, wenn ich
